## HERA — Step 3c: low-field extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0.3 → 1.0 T at 5 mT

> **05:24** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension of run 6: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.3->1.0 T at 5 mT (141 pts), delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 1.0 T · **ETA ~05:39** (≈15 min)

**Spot-check read (runs 6/7, ana):** electron side (run 6, F_L = 33.1 T) carries two fundamentals — 7.1 T (0.21 F_L, 2× harmonic at 14.1) and ≈ 25.7 T (0.78 F_L) — summing to 32.8 T ≈ F_L (Luttinger closes at scale 0.99), plus an ≈ F_L tone that takes over above ~4 T. That is the ABAB pair template (model at 3.2×10¹²: 7.4 / 25.6 T). Hole side (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T) shows one broad ~6 T tone + 12.3 T: consistent-with the near-CNP ABAB beat regime, uninformative as a discriminator, and the TG limit caps that side at 1.27×10¹². **The fan goes electron side.** Its cost on this rig is measurement-dominated (rows ∝ 1/B_lo), and `sdh_onset` on run 6 flags the carrying 7.1 T tone as *censored at the record edge* — the sub-1 T segment of run 6 was 50 mT steps, under-sampled for that tone, so B_lo is not pinned. Per `landau-fan` step 1 (censored carrying tone → cheap low-field extension before committing), this 141-point 5 mT leg from where the magnet sits (0.30 T, end of run 7) to 1.0 T pins the onset and doubles as the grid-change reproduction of the 7.1 T tone (sdh-spot-check Verify). Price: 0.7 T ramp 5 min + 141 × 3.1 s (run-6/7 calibrated: (120 − 73 min)/921 pts) ≈ 7 min → ≈ 13 min, ending at 1.0 T with the gates at the electron spot. Preconditions: base T, B ≈ 0.30 T, V_si = 0, PS heater/output on. Checkpoint: first 20 points (R ≈ 50 Ω at 0.3 T as in run 6, leakage flat); the read (onset → B_lo) lands in ana and sizes the fan proposal that follows.

# === Low-field extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.3 -> 1.0 T at 5 mT — pins the fan's B_lo ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration (ana)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (same point as run 6)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set): base T, magnet parked at 0.3 T by run 7, Si at 0, PS/output on ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (expect 0.30: run 7 ended there), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 0.30) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: 0.30 -> 1.00 T, 5 mT uniform in B (Delta(1/B) = 0.056 /T at 0.3 T = 2.5 samples/period of the 7.1 T tone, 7/period at 0.5 T)
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.30, 1.0001, 0.005), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # 5 kOhm FS as in run 6 (R <= 60 Ohm here)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron, low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.0 T, 5 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform-B 5 mT; pins onset / B_lo for the landau-fan; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.0 T — the fan starts from its B_lo (<= 1 T) next. No park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
